command: Launch existing freshly-built nested_fixture SDK executable; apply config.child to disposable shell below. Child closes stdout, remains alive50ms, then exits7. Keep host stdin open while waiting for error; terminate only afterward.
script:
#!/bin/sh
if [ "$1" = hello ]; then echo '{"provide":["roundtrip"]}'; exit 0; fi
echo '{"not":"ready"}'
exec 1>&-
sleep 0.05
exit 7
hypothesis: Stdout EOF can precede OS exit-status availability; one-shot child.try_wait returns None, then drop kills the child before exit7 can be observed. This is not a stderr drain race and predates observation instrumentation.
initial_probe_note: First subprocess.run probe closed host stdin immediately and ended SDK lifecycle before apply completed; corrected probe keeps pipe open.
